_help: The kinds of team a battle can use, what each man carries, and what the team costs when you choose your forces. experience runs from 0 (raw) to 1 (veteran). nation picks the uniform: british, norwegian or german. Off-map support is bought per mission.

independent_section.about: Keen but newly raised and lightly armed, one Bren between them.
